instruction: Place an order for all mouse pads in my amazon wish list.
notes: The wish list is abstracted as two mouse pads (mouse-pad-1, mouse-pad-2) and one non-mouse-pad item (other-product); at runtime the show_product/move steps are repeated for every wish-list entry whose product_type is 'mouse pad'. Products and the 'mouse pad' product type are domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can name the goal facts. amazon.clear_cart is required before any move so that pre-existing cart items are not ordered (CartEntry changes are ignored by the evaluation); moves are forbidden after the order is placed, so (in-cart ?p) at the end denotes exactly the items contained in the single new order, and in-wish-list quantities are preserved by passing the entry's quantity to move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart. Existing address and payment card are discovered with show_addresses/show_payment_cards (no address is created/updated). If show_wish_list already exposes product_type, the show_product calls can be skipped at runtime. No answer is passed to complete_task.
